key_findings.finding: The tokenized strings decode to Boc-protected aminopyrazino/quinazoline-like hydrazine substrate `CC(C)(C)OC(=O)NNc1c(N)cnc2ccccc12`; a cyclic carboxylic acid `CC1(CCC(=O)O)OCCO1`; EDC-type carbodiimide `CCN=C=NCCCN(C)C`; DMAP, N-methylmorpholine, chloroform, and pyridine. The apparent peroxide-like token is actually the cyclic carboxylic acid after SELFIES decoding, not a peroxide reagent.

The principal covalent transformation is EDC/DMAP-mediated amidation: the exocyclic amino group on the heteroaromatic substrate is acylated by the cyclic carboxylic acid, while the Boc-protected hydrazine remains intact.
